title: Kim 2025, six cables in PAC bedding, summer: Robin top, Dirichlet sides and bottom

physical.source: Kim et al. 2025 (Geothermics 125:103151); 9-layer cable data of the corrected 2025 datasheet
physical.adaptation: Controlled 8 x 4 m domain (the paper domain is far larger); DC losses at 20 C; uniform circular source per conductor. Layer 8 is CLSM-RS10 (k=2.15) and layer 9 the PE casing (k=0.2857).

provenance.citation: examples/kim_2024_154kv_bedding/data (boundary_conditions.csv and cable csv files of this repository)

geometry.note: Cable positions and radii follow the paper layout; the 8 x 4 m domain is a controlled reduction of the paper domain

materials.note: Layers 1-7 from the datasheet; layer 8 CLSM-RS10 k=2.15; layer 9 PE casing k=0.2857; soil strata and PAC patch k from the example csv

source.note: 1026 A, Cu 1200 mm2 (published); losses are DC at 20 C with alpha=0.00393 1/K for copper (user decision B8)

boundary_conditions.note: Top Robin T_air 27.2 C and Dirichlet 15.2 C on the other sides from the example csv; h=14.605 from the published formula h=7.371+6.43*v^0.75 with v=1.17 m/s

inconsistencies.resolution: Copper conductor: 0.00393 1/K (user decision B8); 0.0393 is not used
csv keeps only the no-wind term; the published formula with v=1.17 m/s is used for summer

values.winter_air_temperature: not found in the repository sources

inconsistencies.resolution: No winter case is defined; it is not invented
